proposed_widenings.name: prevent_hp_floor
proposed_widenings.justification: Death Ward intercepts the first event that would reduce the target to 0 HP and sets HP to 1 instead, then the spell expires. No v4 effect atom covers threshold-intercepting HP reduction (heal restores HP after the fact; modify_max_hp changes the ceiling). The operation fires exactly once, consumes the spell, and requires a new atom that denotes 'intercept-and-floor' semantics on the HP-damage pipeline.
proposed_widenings.evidence: The first time the target would drop to 0 Hit Points before the spell ends, the target instead drops to 1 Hit Point, and the spell ends.

proposed_widenings.name: negate_instant_death
proposed_widenings.justification: Death Ward also negates effects that would kill the target instantly without dealing damage (e.g. Disintegrate at 0 HP, Power Word Kill, certain death-save-bypassing features). This is distinct from prevent_hp_floor (no damage involved) and distinct from negate_named_effect (not scoped to one named spell — it covers any effect that would kill instantly without damage). The spell fires once on this trigger, then ends.
proposed_widenings.evidence: If the spell is still in effect when the target is subjected to an effect that would kill it instantly without dealing damage, that effect is negated against the target, and the spell ends.

proposed_widenings.name: OngoingOperation / death_guard
proposed_widenings.justification: A new OngoingOperation variant encoding the two-mode Death Ward protection is needed. The existing OngoingOperation union (roll_modifier | damage_on_hit) has no branch for passive death prevention. The new variant would carry both protect flags and an implicit one-shot-expire semantic (fires once on the first qualifying trigger, then the spell ends).
proposed_widenings.evidence: Both clauses share the structure: condition fires → effect applied → spell ends. Neither maps to roll_modifier or damage_on_hit.

notes: The ongoing_effect family is the right structural home: timed (8 hours), non-concentration, single-target creature, no concentration lock. The attachment (target, mode one, range touch) and duration (timed, 8 hours) shapes exist. The sole gap is in OngoingOperation — neither existing variant (roll_modifier, damage_on_hit) can represent the intercept-and-floor or negate-instant-kill semantics. Both proposed atoms are absent from the v4 effect inventory. The one-shot-expire behavior (fires once then self-terminates early) is also not currently encoded in OngoingEffectMechanics, which implicitly treats operations as persistent for the full duration; a 'oneShot' flag on the mechanics or a lifecycle atom like self_break may also be needed, but the primary gap is the missing effect atoms.
